pages.text: Gun Ammo is used by the $(l:tools/minigun)Minigun/$.$(p)Ammo must be loaded into the Minigun's magazine. Cartridge size and special effects vary by ammunition type.
Plain $(item)Gun Ammo/$ has a large cartridge of 1000 rounds. Potion-tipped ammunition is disabled in Better Content.

pages.title: Potion-Tipped Ammo
pages.text: This recipe is disabled in Better Content.
